admin_dashboard_guidelines.design_style: High-density clean dashboard with warm ivory headers, clear data tables, status badges, and data-testid attributes for all controls.

accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_policy: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include explicit data-testid attributes (kebab-case).
accessibility_and_testing.apca_contrast: Dark mahogany text (#2D1810) on ivory background (#FAF7F2) meets 7.5:1 APCA contrast ratio.
accessibility_and_testing.motion_policy: Respect prefers-reduced-motion by providing static graceful layouts when motion is disabled.
accessibility_and_testing.dropdown_rule: NEVER use pure transparent backgrounds on dropdowns, modals, or fixed navigation bars. Always provide solid/glass background with backdrop blur.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the light off-white (#FAF7F2 / #FAF8F4) background theme.
Ensure all 16 beads in the circular selector function correctly with genuine bead PNG images.
Preserve all data-testid attributes in React .js files.
Ensure both visible consultation form and popup consultation form work seamlessly with lead submission API.
Ensure Admin panel provides complete CMS editing for text, images, and lead management while preserving login credentials.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not use dark backgrounds for marketing or footer sections.
Always maintain high contrast between text (#2D1810) and background (#FAF7F2).
Include data-testid on every interactive button, input, tab, card, and link.
Do not introduce Om/mantra symbols or star constellation lines in the hero section.
Ensure responsive support down to 320px screen width without text/image collisions.
